stdout:
ZXS storage and Web management daemon

Usage: zxs [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>
          [default: ./zxs-data]
      --management-root <MANAGEMENT_ROOT>
          System-disk management state; defaults to ROOT/management, never a data member
      --setup-disk <SETUP_DISKS>
          Locally approved existing disk root, repeated as opaque ID=/absolute/path
      --setup-config <SETUP_CONFIGS>
          Locally reviewed private configuration preset, repeated as ID=/absolute/file
      --allow-development-setup
          Test-only: allow directory-backed development pool setup, never physical disk validation
      --listen <LISTEN>
          [default: 127.0.0.1:7400]
      --external-origin <EXTERNAL_ORIGIN>
          
      --trusted-proxy-ip <TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS>
          Trust this exact loopback proxy peer; it must overwrite X-Forwarded-For with one IP
      --web-dir <WEB_DIR>
          
      --max-upload-bytes <MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES>
          [default: 1073741824]
      --http-spool-bytes-per-account <HTTP_SPOOL_BYTES_PER_ACCOUNT>
          HTTP spool quota only, including retained generations and metadata allowance [default: 107374182400]
      --http-spool-bytes-total <HTTP_SPOOL_BYTES_TOTAL>
          [default: 536870912000]
      --http-spool-recovery-reserve-bytes <HTTP_SPOOL_RECOVERY_RESERVE_BYTES>
          Keep this filesystem headroom outside new upload reservations [default: 1073741824]
      --http-transfer-slots-total <HTTP_TRANSFER_SLOTS_TOTAL>
          Independent capacity for each HTTP upload/read pool [default: 8]
      --http-transfer-slots-per-account <HTTP_TRANSFER_SLOTS_PER_ACCOUNT>
          [default: 2]
      --http-transfer-idle-seconds <HTTP_TRANSFER_IDLE_SECONDS>
          [default: 60]
      --http-transfer-total-seconds <HTTP_TRANSFER_TOTAL_SECONDS>
          [default: 3600]
      --smb-socket <SMB_SOCKET>
          
      --smb-peer-uid <SMB_PEER_UID>
          
      --smb-user <SMB_USER>
          
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version

stdout:
Offline verified recovery; stop ZXS before use

Usage: zxs-rescue [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  configuration     Prepare or safely edit uninitialized topology drafts; never mutates a live pool
  restore-system    
  recovery-preview  
  recovery-commit   
  package           Export, verify or restore a complete independently validated history package
  offline-check     
  offline-export    
  help              Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>            [default: ./zxs-data]
      --principal <PRINCIPAL>  [default: admin]
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version

restore-system requires at least two trusted original metadata members.
Recovery preview/commit only accepts decided, unpublished operations with all original disks accessible. It requires a reviewed digest and explicit permanent-loss acknowledgement; it is not a reset or missing-disk replacement.
Offline export validates one published version, not the entire pool or current permissions.
